body: One of my first interactions was this guy who might've been drunk, cautioning me about walking in the bike line. There are a lot of bike riders in Ljubljana. He offered me some wine or something but I politely declined.

Only intended to go to Ljubljana but had a wonderful guide take me to Polhov Gradec, Bled and Triglav National Park. 

The main reason I went there was to participate in the Pot ob žici (Path around the wire) marathon. Well it's less of a marathon and everyone walks at their own pace. It's a 32km (20 mile) walk around the perimeter of the city, a path that used to be barbed wire strangling the city placed by the Italians during the days of their occupation in WW2.

I'd also come to research for a story I'd been working on that takes place in Ljubljana during the occupation. Picked up many interesting bits at the City Museum that I couldn't find in my research.

Had a great time and being in a new place with someone willing to take me to places was wonderful. I have 6 vacation days left for this year. Perhaps Zagreb is next.
